individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked area/bar plot shows median state frequency per Pol II-level bin aggregated over thousands of promoters; this is a continuous binned distribution summary, analogous to a heatmap/density representation, not a small-n mean plot requiring overlaid replicate points.

The single-molecule stack already displays every individual molecule (one row per molecule) as a heatmap-like plot; the adjoining state-frequency sidebar is a proportion summary, not a mean requiring individual points.
Same binned median-frequency stacked plot representation as panel A, aggregating thousands of promoters per bin.
Same single-molecule stack representation as panel B, showing every individual molecule directly.
Box plot; box plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since they already display the distribution.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The middle line of the box represents the median. The box displays the interquartile range (IQR), 25th to 75th percentile. Whiskers represent a distance of 1.5 x IQR.
